evidence.quote: if not (books.Books.Customers.IsEmpty && books.Books.Drafts.IsEmpty && books.Books.Invoices.IsEmpty && books.Payments.IsEmpty) then

ARC-REV-01.rationale: Every new rule is in Tier 2. Summa.Storage.Transfer owns the file format, the checks and the order of refusals, and reuses LocalSnapshot and Exports.dataVersion. The engine (Summa.Web.Engine) owns the rules for GitHub books, the files pack and 'new books only'. The Tier 3 wire only maps kernel events to engine messages, and the HTML only binds view values. Tier 3/4 makes no domain decision.

evidence.quote: match Transfer.export manifest books ctx.Now with

ARC-REV-02.rationale: No effect is performed in Tier 1/2. The time comes in through Ctx.Now rather than a clock read. The download and the persistence are requested as data (an OfferDownload effect, and a SaveBooks effect through the existing save helper) for the edge to carry out. Transfer.fs is pure: it parses JSON with Arca's pure Json and uses no System.IO or System.Text.Json.

evidence.quote: | _ when not model.Packs.Files -> { model with Error = Some "This browser cannot offer downloads here." }, []

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The change reuses the existing single definitions: the classification is Exports.Classification, the data version is Exports.dataVersion, the snapshot comes from LocalSnapshot.encode/decode, and the date text from Codec.dateText and Organization.businessDate. Schema and Version are each defined once. The only restatement is the user-facing message 'This browser cannot offer downloads here.', copied from the existing download handler. The copies agree, and it is a message rather than a domain fact.

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The counting rule (Transfer.contents) and the contents check are in Tier 2 Storage. The preview text is built in the Tier 2 engine from Transfer.read and Transfer.contents. The HTML only shows the view value, and no Tier 3 code is changed.

evidence.quote: | BooksTransferTextChanged v -> { model with BooksTransferText = v; BooksTransferPreview = booksTransferPreview v }, []

ARC-REV-02.rationale: Nothing here adds an effect. The preview is a pure function of the pasted text, the contents are computed purely, and the transition returns no effects.

evidence.quote: | Some(Json.Number n) when n = 1m || n = decimal Version ->
elif n = 2m && contentsOf document <> Some(contents restored.Books) then

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The counts have one definition (Transfer.contents), used by export, read and the preview. But the format version that carries 'contents' is written as the literal 2m next to the Version constant, and version 1 is a bare 1m literal. The copies agree today. If Version is raised, the contents check would still be tied to 2m on its own, so the version fact is restated rather than referenced.
